tweets.text:
THE TRUMP EFFECT

Illegal aliens released into the United States from Jan 20, 2024 to April 1, 2024 under Biden - 184,241.  January 20, 2025 to April 1, 2025 under Trump - 9.  And 8 of those were either material witnesses in a criminal case or a significant medical emergency.  And we are looking for the 184,241.   The leadership of President Trump has been a game changer.
~ Thomas D. Homan
    U.S. Border Czar

tweets.text:
TRUMP EFFECT #2

Criminal aliens arrested at our southern border and denied entry thus far under Trump - 1,015. Criminal Aliens arrested by ICE in the interior U.S thus far under Trump - 34, 942 to include  3,799 Dangerous Drugs,  1,042 Weapon Offenses,  969 Sexual Assaults,  452 Robbery and 373 Homicide.  God bless the men and women of the Border Patrol and Immigration and Customs Enforcement who stand on the front line and put themselves in harms way 24/7 to protect our communities. Every criminal alien and national security threat not allowed entry or removed from this great nation makes this country safer. President Trump said he would make this country safe again and it is happening every day.  Promises made. Promises kept.
~ Thomas D. Homan
    U. S. Border Czar
